roleContext.jobDescription: Our frozen-foods factory makes ready meals and frozen desserts on six production lines for supermarket own-label ranges. The Supply Planning Lead turns the consensus demand plan into the weekly master production schedule, signs that schedule off with the factory manager, chairs the stock review with the warehouse and customer service teams and keeps planning parameters accurate in the ERP. The role calls for senior planning experience: the planning director wants at least two years in a senior planner role with sign-off on the master production schedule, plus a recognised planning certification.

Maintains planning master data such as lead times and lot sizes in the ERP.
Holds a recognised supply-chain planning certification such as CPIM or CSCP.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Supply Planning Lead, Frozen Foods

## Experience

- Supply Planner, Marlow & Teague Frozen Foods (March 2021 to April 2025): built the weekly master production schedule proposal for two freezer lines from the demand plan and line capacities, and passed it to the planning manager for sign-off every Thursday.
- Ran the Thursday stock review with the warehouse and customer service teams, listing each item below safety stock with the agreed recovery action and the person responsible for it.
- Senior Supply Chain Planner, Corrie Bay Seafoods (May 2025 to January 2026): planning role covering the chilled and frozen ranges.
- Planning Analyst, Marlow & Teague Frozen Foods (September 2019 to February 2021): maintained item master data, supplier lead times and minimum lot sizes in the ERP and produced the weekly forecast-accuracy report by product family.
- Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM), awarded by ASCM in October 2022.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised master production schedule proposal for one week on two freezer lines, showing demand by item, line capacity in hours, changeover allowances and the planning manager's approval stamp.
